title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Antique Pewter | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch, Antique Pewter
description:
Need more bathroom storage without giving up counter space? This wall-mounted glass shelf adds an easy spot for daily essentials and includes an integrated towel bar for grab-and-go convenience in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics.

Highlights:
- Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
- Pairs with matching Waverly Place accessories for understated elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Count on enduring hardware with solid brass construction
- Coordinate your bathroom with the Waverly Place Collection for a matching Waverly Place look

Specs & Installation:
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Glass size: 16 x 5 Inches
- Overall projection: 5 Inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch (3/8 Inch)
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Multiple designer finish options available
